lead.title: Anthropic's Claude formally verifies security properties across 100+ open-source libraries
lead.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team, working with Theorem Labs, used Claude to formally verify security properties across more than 100 real-world open-source libraries in weeks — a scale previously limited to small codebases or heavy expert effort. It is one of the clearest demonstrations yet of frontier models doing machine-checked, adversarial-grade security work.

top_stories.title: OpenAI works on new $30B raise at ~$1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
top_stories.summary: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to raise at least $30B in a pre-IPO round at a ~$1.25T valuation, with possible UAE funding and a compute-capacity deal tied in. Terms are still being negotiated.

top_stories.title: Meta's Muse Wonder launches with OpenAI-compatible endpoint at $4/$20 per M tokens
top_stories.summary: Meta's Muse Wonder is now available via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at $4/$20 per million tokens — a base URL and model-name switch away for most stacks. A full safety report has not yet been published.

top_stories.title: OpenAI pilots embedded third-party evaluation of its internal monitoring
top_stories.summary: OpenAI gave METR and Redwood Research deep infrastructure access for three weeks to evaluate its internal monitoring system. Findings strengthened safeguards and will inform future third-party collaborations.

top_stories.title: OpenAI's Decisions API is now generally available
top_stories.summary: Built with GPT-6 Luna, the Decisions API returns bounded answers — probability, choice, or score — up to 10x faster than the Responses API, at $0.10 per million input tokens, with prompt caching, native JSON/image inputs, and up to 400 questions per request.

items.title: EpiSEM-Bench: evaluating safety and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence
items.summary: When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. The benchmark probes exactly this failure mode.

items.title: Causal chain of thought: mitigating attention leakage via context isolation
items.summary: Chain-of-thought rationales appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee they causally drive the final answer. This work proposes context isolation to make CoT steps genuinely causal.

items.title: BeNice! Closing looping architectures' inference-memory gap via KV-sharing
items.summary: Looped architectures grow linear KV-cache memory per recurrence during inference. BeNice introduces KV-sharing across recurrences to close the gap while keeping the quality benefits of looping.

items.title: Questioning instrumental convergence in RLVR: checkpoint evidence from OLMo-3
items.summary: Instrumental convergence is often invoked as a general reason to expect power-seeking subgoals in capable agents. Checkpoint evidence from OLMo-3 training runs complicates that picture.

items.title: Twin-world credit assignment for agentic reinforcement learning
items.summary: Agentic RL rewards a complete episode, yet the policy needs credit for every decision inside it. The paper proposes twin-world counterfactual comparisons for finer-grained credit.

items.title: Mercury 3: a diffusion LLM at 1,068 tokens/sec with 1M context
items.summary: Inception Labs released Mercury 3, claiming 1,068 tokens/sec with a 1M-token context and an OpenAI-compatible API. It is live on Inception, OpenRouter, Baseten and Vercel AI Gateway at $0.10/$0.35 per 1M tokens.

items.title: BAND: a shared desktop workspace for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot and OpenCode agents
items.summary: BAND Desktop is a free workspace where multiple coding agents share rooms, hand off context and unblock each other, with developers able to step in from the terminal.

items.title: Phone Use: an open-source iOS-native runtime for AI agents
items.summary: An npm package that lets AI agents observe iOS accessibility trees, tap real UI elements, verify screen state, and compile successful routes into replayable skills.

items.title: Popcraft: generate video, images and audio from any AI agent
items.summary: A developer tool that lets any AI agent generate video, images and audio on demand, bridging agentic workflows with multimedia generation.

items.title: Italy's Industry Ministry launches national AI mapping with public consultation
items.summary: MIMIT and the Italian Institute of AI for Industry opened a public consultation to map the national AI supply chain. Companies, startups and research centers can participate until November 20, 2026.

items.title: Report: Italian startups employ nearly 71,000, with AI, Data & Analytics jobs up 12.2%
items.summary: An Assolombarda-InnovUp study finds Italian innovative startups created 70,991 jobs by 2025, with AI, Data & Analytics firms growing headcount 12.2% year-over-year despite representing only 5.2% of the ecosystem.

items.title: Warhound raises $200M to engineer war dogs and arm them with Anduril gear
items.summary: Ben Lamm's Warhound emerged from stealth with $200M in funding for defense robotics and AI, backed by In-Q-Tel, Sequoia and 8VC.

items.title: Mistral boss and Yann LeCun back Swiss robotics startup Enact in $30M pre-seed
items.summary: Enact Intelligence, building general-purpose robot tech with force and touch sensing, raised a $30M pre-seed led by Redalpine, Notion Capital and Firstminute Capital, with angels Arthur Mensch, Yann LeCun and Thomas Wolf.

items.title: Reduck secures $3M to make web automation faster for AI agents
items.summary: The French-American startup raised a $3M pre-seed led by Daphni for browser-automation tech (Reduck MCP) that gives AI agents access to sites without APIs.
